title: Natural-number labels for circuit vertices
statement: Let $F$ be a layered circuit with Boolean values and $n$ input wires, and let $m$ be a nonnegative integer with $m c mathrm{depth}(F)+1$. Assign each node $u$ in layer $m$ a natural-number label as follows: in layer $0$, its label is the index of the corresponding input wire; in layer $m+1$, its label is $n$ plus the total number of successor nodes in layers $0$ through $m-1$, plus the position of $u$ in an enumeration of layer $m+1$.
hypotheses_covered: F is a layered circuit with Boolean values and n input wires
F has finitely many nodes in each layer
F uses only the standard gate operations
u is a node in layer m
